-- This year marks 25 years since the 9/11 terror attack, and the National September 11 Memorial & Museum will hold its annual commemoration ceremony to remember the victims.

Families of victims will gather for the ceremony on the 9/11 Memorial Plaza to read aloud the names of the 2,983 men, women, and children killed in the September 11, 2001 attacks and the February 26, 1993 bombing of the World Trade Center.
